title: Typed inference pipeline
description: Typed pipeline DAG contract (specs/51). A pipeline is an acyclic graph of runtime-family stages. Each stage references exactly one family from the specs/48 registry and lists its upstream stage_ids in `dependencies` (DAG edges). Acyclicity, dependency resolution, family admission, and output/input modality matching are semantic validation rules that JSON Schema cannot express; a violation is reported with the error envelope in schemas/v1/errors/error.json using the codes in `x-validation-errors`.

inputs.description: Entrypoint inputs, keyed by input name.

x-validation-errors.pipeline_cycle: The stage dependency graph contains a cycle.
x-validation-errors.pipeline_unknown_dependency: A stage depends on a stage_id that is not in the pipeline.
x-validation-errors.pipeline_unknown_family: A stage references a family absent from the canonical registry or not admitted.
x-validation-errors.pipeline_io_mismatch: A stage output does not match a downstream stage input (modality + shape).

family.description: Runtime family id from the canonical registry (specs/48).

dependencies.description: stage_ids this stage depends on (DAG edges).
